race.description: Ladbrokes Big Bets Copy Now Mdn F
race.comment: RINGBARK GUS (4) was a (19.31) winner last time out at this track from Box 4. Solid beginner who can clear the tricky draw. Looks a key chance if runs up to latest figure. THERMODYNAMIC (3) failed to threaten on debut finishing fourth (19.50) at this track over 350m. Can improve sharply here. NIGHTS BUT YOUNG (1) placed two back in a Maiden at this track then backed that up with a second (19.19) over 350m at this track last time. Safe beginner and drawn well on the inside. Rates a winning chance on best. CABERNET CARTEL (8) was in the money last start after showing early dash - poses a threat again.
